name: nailflow
description: Booking and management platform for nail studios.

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @nailflow/shared && concurrently -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w @nailflow/api" "npm run dev -w @nailflow/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @nailflow/shared && npm run build -w @nailflow/api && npm run build -w @nailflow/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @nailflow/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.lint: npm run build -w @nailflow/shared && eslint "apps/api/src/**/*.ts" "packages/**/src/**/*.ts" && npm run lint -w @nailflow/web
